origin.description: Capabilities assumed when term.cap is left unset.
origin.details: Bright and 256-color SGR are always assumed. Truecolor is added when the COLORTERM environment variable is truecolor or 24bit.

translation.description: Capabilities assumed when term.cap is left unset.
translation.details: Bright and 256-color SGR are always assumed. Truecolor is added when COLORTERM is truecolor or 24bit.
translation.example:
import os
from fansi import dflt_term_cap
os.environ["COLORTERM"] = ""
print(", ".join(dflt_term_cap()))
